description: Before your agent reads a web page: does the site allow it, for which use (search, answer, training, agent), and at what price? Reads the site's AI Terms file (/.well-known/ai-terms) and answers for one URL and one use. Free. AI Terms is a file a website publishes at /.well-known/ai-terms that says, for each use of its content by AI (search, answer, training, agent), whether that use is allowed, allowed for a price, or not allowed.

url.description: The page you want to read, e.g. https://example.com/blog/post

use.description: What you will do with it: search, answer, training or agent

name: ai_terms
title: AI Terms lookup
